name: codex-url-vault
description: Local URL library with task-oriented MCP tools for saved links, Brave or Chrome current-page capture, a native macOS app, and Codex Browser/IAB.

interface.shortDescription: Save this browser URL or manage one local Vault.
interface.longDescription: A local URL library with a SwiftUI app, task-oriented stdio MCP tools including voice-friendly current Brave or Chrome page capture, a responsive Codex Browser/IAB Viewer, and selectable browser extensions backed by a native Rust host.
capabilities: Selectable Brave or Chrome current-page capture
defaultPrompt: Open Codex URL Vault and show my saved URLs.
Show Codex URL Vault inside Codex Browser/IAB, then find or save URLs for my current task.
Save this URL—the current Brave or Chrome page—to Codex URL Vault.
